product_one_liner.value: Owl.co provides AI that turns insurance claim files into structured, cited evidence for claims, special-investigation, legal and underwriting teams.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link or plans appear in the navigation/footer, and the pricing URL did not return a public pricing page.

named_customers.notes: The published case studies describe unnamed insurers rather than disclose at least two customer names.

employee_band.notes: Reported employee band, not an independently verified headcount.

eng_blog.notes: The index contains insurance-AI thought leadership and product content, not two qualifying engineer-authored posts about building Owl.

public_docs.notes: A documentation overview exists, but its guide links are placeholders rather than several readable public articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: None of the ten listed openings has a qualifying AI, ML or data-science title; the Data Quality Analyst role does not qualify.

model_provider.notes: The documentation names Owl-1.5 in its model-card section. No external foundation-model provider was identified; AWS is listed only for cloud service and hosting.

compliance_certs.notes: SOC 2 is presented as Type II. These are public compliance claims; ISO 27001 certification was not independently verified.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest disclosed round found was November 2021, before the requested May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live Enterprise Account Executive opening in Vancouver with an application link.

launched_6mo.notes: Template Assistant was introduced May 9, 2026, on the opening boundary of the requested May 9–November 9 window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No qualifying dated join or departure was found for November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 in the small leadership roster and checked profiles.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The account-executive posting requires forecasting in Salesforce.
